cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: Years of genetic experiments resulted in the creation of this never-before-seen violent Pokémon.

cards.name: Cool Porygon
cards.description: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Dark Persian
cards.description: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Meowth
cards.description: This Pokémon is more active at night. It likes bright, shiny things and cannot resist taking them and adding them to its collection.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: A wild Pokémon with a short temper. It is able to distinguish colors, and likes the color red.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: The flames on this legendary Pokémon's wings burn so brightly that they can make night seem like day.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon is said to freeze the water in the air during winter, causing snow.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon is said to be present wherever there is a lightning storm.

cards.name: Flying Pikachu
cards.description: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It uses its sensitive tail to sense its environment and has been known to react violently if its tail is grabbed.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Surfing Pikachu
cards.description: One summer, a group of Pikachus was found riding the waves at the local beach.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: Years of genetic experiments resulted in the creation of this never-before-seen violent Pokémon.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: Still only a hatchling, it uses poison to chase off its enemies when threatened.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.description: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.description: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Unown [J]
cards.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, they attract so much electricity that they can cause lightning to strike.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: This Pokémon can fly is spite of its large bulk. It is said to be able to circumnavigate the earth in just 16 hours.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon famous for its beauty. It looks almost as if it flies when it runs.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
